text_block_list.text: Despite it being a day off, Taiki Shuttle showed up at the Trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeees! Today is the day my friends
Suzuka and Fukukitaru are racing!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: And so, I came over so we could cheer together on TV, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Is the carrot juice ready, YES?
When our friend wins, we shall celebrate in front of the TV, YES!
And so, the two of us ended up watching the race broadcast together with Taiki Shuttle, but—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "Silence Suzuka, on an extreme runaway lead, widens the gap even further on the final stretch!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"She's running all alone now!
Leaving the rest of the pack more than 10 lengths behind, she crosses the finish line!"
To win a graded race by such a massive margin...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka's been amazing ever since returning from Hong Kong!
That makes it 4 wins in a row, YES!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
As your friend, I am so happy!
When you come back to the academy, I will give you a hug!

She was taking on various challenges
in order to discover her own style of running.
It seems she has found the answer.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer!
What are you spacing out for, hm?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Since Suzuka got the victory,
it's time for a celebration party!

I can't take my eyes off what she'll do next—
That's just how deeply this race left an impression on me.
